facts.did: 事实与自己对外说的相反：Gardenpath 每一晚都进到 Murtis 体内
facts.anchor: Gardenpath had gone inside Murtis every night

facts.did: 靠那些采矿论文想出在 galaxysuit 面料上做出半透补丁，并加装转导机制以安全地感知外部
facts.anchor: create semipermeable patches in the suit’s fabric

facts.did: 在图书馆上层找到空通风口、读取官方笔记本里的数据，开始勾画以 Pompeii 为中心的食物网推拉关系
facts.anchor: started to sketch out the dynamic push-pull of the food web

facts.did: 在 Gardenpath 记录 Tentacle 观察时悄然走近，说“你必须告诉 Murtis 真相”
facts.anchor: You have to tell Murtis the truth.

facts.did: 引用 Gable 在 Skiff 的研究为自己辩护：他们假装成失散多年的亲戚以取得 Spinners 线人的信任
facts.anchor: pretended to be a long-lost cousin to gain the trust

facts.did: 承认自己对 Murtis 所作的事感觉很糟，并问告知真相是否会成为混杂因素、毁掉结果
facts.anchor: I feel really awful about what I did to Murtis

facts.did: 指出 Gardenpath 通过与 Murtis 同住共事，已经改变了他们的行为
facts.anchor: changed their behavior, by dwelling and working with them

facts.did: 把一条友好的手臂滑到 Gardenpath 的膜下，说他们可能夸大了自己的困惑，因为不愿接受明显的结论
facts.anchor: slid a friendly arm under Gardenpath’s membrane

relations.relation: 伦理劝诫：不能未经许可就进入某人内部，即使对方是多细胞生物
relations.anchor: You can’t just go inside somebody without their permission

relations.relation: 说谎：Gardenpath 假装伪聚簇（pseudo-clustering）只发生过一次
relations.anchor: pretending that the pseudo-clustering only happened once

relations.relation: 朋友式支持：怀疑 Gardenpath 是因为在乎 Murtis 才与其簇合，并认为这没问题
relations.anchor: you clustered with Murtis because you care about them

relations.relation: 告知离开：Gardenpath 对 Murtis 说自己必须离开一段时间、但会回来
relations.anchor: I had to leave for a while, but that I would be back

numbers.fact: Oriel 说 Gable 的做法是五代之前的事，文化研究已经向前走了
numbers.anchor: Gable? That was five generations ago.

numbers.fact: 进入 Murtis（即使只用极小的触手）本可能害死两者中的一方或双方
numbers.anchor: could have killed one or both of them

numbers.fact: Gardenpath 不想毁掉自己第二次考试（Second Exam）的数据
numbers.anchor: I don’t want to wreck my Second Exam data
